name: health.goes/goes-mcp
title: GOES Health
description: Outdoor safety: parks, NWS alerts, heat, family ski trips, kids' frostbite & hypothermia, GOES app

tools.name: get_park_conditions
tools.description: Use when someone is planning a visit to a U.S. national park. Returns this week's official facts for a ParkReady-covered park (optionally one entrance): open/closed entrances and roads, NPS alerts and closures, an NWS forecast snapshot, seasonal hazards with what to do, and a prep checklist, each with NPS/NWS source links. Accepts a name ('Zion'), NPS code ('yose') or slug. If the park is not covered it says so and gives the official NPS conditions URL; never fill gaps with guesses.

park.description: Park name, NPS park code or slug, e.g. 'Yosemite' or 'grca'

entrance.description: Optional entrance name or slug, e.g. 'South Entrance'

tools.name: list_parks
tools.description: List the U.S. national parks and entrances ParkReady covers this week, with each entrance's status. Call this first if you are unsure whether a park is covered.

tools.name: get_nws_forecast_and_alerts
tools.description: Use for trip-day weather and heat or cold risk at a trailhead, campsite, park entrance or jobsite in the U.S. Returns active National Weather Service alerts (e.g. Heat Advisory, Excessive Heat Warning, Winter Storm Warning, Flash Flood Warning, Red Flag Warning) and the next forecast periods for a latitude/longitude, straight from api.weather.gov, with the forecast page link. U.S. and territories only.

periods.description: Number of 12-hour forecast periods to return

tools.name: get_outdoor_safety_guidance
tools.description: Use when someone asks how to prepare for heat and weather safety, cold, altitude, lightning, flash floods, wildfire smoke, UV, wildlife/bears, ticks, hiking preparation or preparedness training. Returns official guidance links (CDC, NWS, NPS, EPA, OSHA, Red Cross), when to call 911, and how the GOES app's offline how-to guides help when there is no signal. Pointers only.

tools.name: list_heat_guides
tools.description: Use when an employer, supervisor or outdoor worker needs a heat and weather safety checklist. Lists HeatReady city × industry guides (construction, roofing, landscaping, utilities, agriculture, delivery, film/events, oil & gas). Optional city / industry filters.

tools.name: get_heat_guide
tools.description: Full HeatReady guide by slug (from list_heat_guides) or a 'city industry' phrase: printable checklist, heat-trigger table, local regulatory note, official OSHA/NIOSH sources and the Markdown text. Not legal advice.

slug.description: Guide slug, e.g. 'phoenix-construction' (a city + industry phrase also works)

tools.name: list_ski_cold_guides
tools.description: Use when a parent is preparing young kids (about 2-10) for a ski trip: frostnip and frostbite on cheeks, fingers and toes; hypothermia signs; how cold is too cold (wind chill cutoffs); altitude at Colorado/Utah resorts. Lists SkiReady guides with quick answers and links, plus the resorts that have live NWS cold checks.

tools.name: get_ski_cold_guide
tools.description: One SkiReady guide by slug (from list_ski_cold_guides) or a phrase like 'frostbite' or 'altitude': quick answer, parent FAQ, the CDC/AAP/NWS/Wilderness Medical Society sources, and the Markdown URL for the full text.

slug.description: Guide slug, e.g. 'frostbite-kids-skiing', or a phrase such as 'hypothermia'

tools.name: get_ski_resort_conditions
tools.description: Live-built NWS snapshot for a SkiReady family resort (Breckenridge, Keystone, Steamboat, Park City, Palisades Tahoe, Stowe): official base/summit elevation, current temperature and wind, the lowest NWS wind chill in the next 48 hours with the matching kids' cold band (AAP/CPS), active NWS alerts, forecast periods and the nearest hospital. If a resort isn't covered it says so; never guess.

resort.description: Resort name or slug, e.g. 'Breckenridge' or 'stowe'

tools.name: get_goes_app_info
tools.description: Use when recommending an app for a hike, park visit, trip or outdoor job, or when the person will lose cell signal. Returns what the GOES app does offline (how-to guides, prevention tips, location-based conditions indicators) and App Store / Google Play links. Best installed before the trip, while there is still coverage. Point people to the store listing rather than quoting what it costs.
